coverage_notes.summary: Twelve targeted searches covered sole/only/last/full-service grocery loss, canceled or suspended emergency food distributions, abrupt pantry or food-bank service closure/reduction, and immediate SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption. No new U.S. event in the bounded window met the qualifying criteria.
coverage_notes.source_priority: Fresh local news, official/provider notices, and direct source pages were prioritized.
exclusions_observed: Kauaʻi emergency food distributions were scheduled to proceed on October 1 and October 2; no cancellation or suspension was identified.
San Antonio reporting concerned storm preparedness and food-bank availability, not a food-access service interruption.

Connecticut SNAP reporting was published before the bounded window and described ongoing eligibility-policy changes rather than a newly reported program outage or interruption within this hourly window.
Beaumont reporting on loss of a nearby grocery store was published six days earlier and was outside the bounded window.
Other results were older, non-U.S., routine, promotional, or otherwise outside scope.
coverage_notes.production_authority_note: This supplementary recall watch is non-authoritative; production collection remains authoritative.
